content_sections.text: The Atomic Energy Education Society has issued Recruitment Notification 01/2026 for 254 posts across its schools in India. The detailed notification includes category-wise and subject-wise vacancies, academic qualifications, age relaxation, selection rules, application fees, examination patterns and document requirements. Official Recruitment Notices: AEES Recruitment Notice PDF

content_sections.heading: AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must satisfy the prescribed educational qualification, teacher-training requirements, CTET conditions and experience rules for their selected post. The notification provides different eligibility routes for school leadership, postgraduate teaching and primary-level teaching positions. Important: The table summarizes the principal qualification routes. Candidates must verify the exact subject combinations, minimum marks, alternative qualifications and experience requirements in Recruitment Notification 01/2026 before applying. Principal candidates must have a Master's Degree with at least 50% marks, a qualifying B.Ed. or integrated teacher-education qualification with at least 50% marks, and computer knowledge. They must also satisfy one of the prescribed experience routes: Working as Principal in Pay Level 12 in an eligible Government or autonomous organization. Three years as Vice-Principal in Pay Level 10. Twelve years of regular service as PGT/Lecturer in Pay Level 8. Twelve years of combined qualifying service as PGT and Vice-Principal under the notified conditions. Vice-Principal applicants must have a Master's Degree with at least 50% marks, the prescribed teacher-education qualification, and computer knowledge. Eligible experience routes include working as Vice-Principal in Pay Level 10 or at least six years as PGT/Lecturer in Pay Level 8 in the specified Government or autonomous organizations. The notification specifies subject combinations for certain TGT positions that must be satisfied at Graduation level. Important: The notification specifically states that candidates with B.Sc. (Hons.) in Physics or Chemistry are not eligible for TGT Mathematics-Physics. Applicants must satisfy the relevant subject combination rather than relying only on their degree title. CTET is mandatory for the applicable TGT and PRT posts. The CTET certificate must be valid and issued on or before the application closing date wherever CTET is compulsory. Candidates should refer to the post-specific eligibility provisions for the exact requirement.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload scanned documents relevant to their selected post and produce the required originals and self-attested copies during verification. Recent colour photograph in the prescribed format. Class 10 certificate or marksheet for date-of-birth proof. Class 12 certificate and marksheet, where applicable. Graduation degree and semester/year-wise marksheets. Postgraduate degree and marksheets, where applicable. B.Ed., D.El.Ed., B.El.Ed., Nursery Education or other prescribed teacher-training certificates. CTET Paper-I or Paper-II certificate, where required. Experience and service certificates for Principal, Vice-Principal or other applicable posts. SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS certificate, if applicable. PwBD certificate and relevant supporting documents, where applicable. No Objection Certificate for serving employees, where required. Other documents prescribed by the online portal for the selected post. Document Scanning Requirement: The notification instructs candidates to use a proper scanner rather than a mobile phone camera or scanning application. File-size and format specifications must be followed as displayed on the recruitment portal. Candidates reaching the Skill Test or Interview stage must satisfy the notified Police Verification Certificate requirements. Serving employees of the specified Government, PSU and autonomous organizations must produce the applicable original NOC and vigilance clearance.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: AEES Recruitment Notification 01/2026 announces 254 vacancies, including Principal, Vice-Principal, PGT, TGT, Librarian, Primary Teacher, PRT Music and Balvatika Teacher posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application and complete fee payment is 22 November 2026 at 11:50 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualifications vary by post and include 12th Pass with prescribed teacher-training credentials, Graduation, Postgraduation, B.Ed., CTET and relevant experience for applicable positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 30 years for PRT and Balvatika, 35 years for TGT and Librarian, 40 years for PGT, 45 years for Vice-Principal and 50 years for Principal, subject to applicable relaxation.

faq.question: Q5. What is the AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026 application fee?
faq.answer: Non-exempt candidates must pay Rs. 750 application fee plus Rs. 250 processing fee. Women, SC, ST, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen candidates pay only the Rs. 250 processing fee. Applicable GST is additional.

faq.question: Q6. Is CTET mandatory for AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: CTET Paper-I is required for Primary Teacher and CTET Paper-II for applicable TGT posts. The notification provides exemptions for certain specialist teaching positions.

faq.question: Q7. What is the AEES Teaching Recruitment 2026 selection process?
faq.answer: Selection includes CBT followed by an Interview for Principal and Vice-Principal or a qualifying Skill Test for other posts. Medical fitness and document verification are also required.

faq.question: Q8. Is there negative marking in the AEES CBT?
faq.answer: No. The notification specifically states that there is no negative marking in the Computer Based Test.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for AEES teaching posts?
faq.answer: The posts fall under Pay Levels 6 to 12, with pay scales ranging from Rs. 35,400-1,12,400 for Level 6 positions to Rs. 78,800-2,09,200 for Principal.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates apply for more than one AEES teaching post?
faq.answer: Candidates may apply for different permitted posts with separate fees. However, only one subject can be selected within PGT and only one subject within TGT.
